exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, emergency C-section, elective C-section)
outcome: Quality of postpartum recovery (assessed using the French version of the Obstetric Quality of Recovery-10 (ObsQoR-10-French) scale)
cohort: 500 French women who underwent either a vaginal delivery or a cesarean section
finding: The ObsQoR-10-French is a valid and reliable psychometric questionnaire, capable of assessing the quality of postpartum recovery in French-speaking populations.
mod_finding: The need for a C-section was negatively associated with the ObsQoR-10-French score, indicating worse quality of recovery after C-section.
